Decreto N° 1335 (2019) Art. 1 incorporates GMC Res. 12/11 as its Annex; Art. 6: in force from promulgation (day/month on the scan's date line is OCR-illegible). Table heading is 'ARSÉNICO' with no speciation, so the register's tAs reading is the instrument's only (unspeciated/total) arsenic measure. Basis: Annex §1.6 'los contenidos máximos se aplican al producto en el estado en que se ofrece al consumidor'; §2.4 fish/fishery products as consumed eviscerated, without head and thorax where applicable (whole fish if eaten whole); §2.7 limits in mg/kg. Held GMC Res. 12/11 text carries the same 1,00 values. Amended only for the rice row by GMC Res. 18/21 (13 Oct 2021), incorporated in Paraguay by Decreto N° 8658/2022 (INAN normativas listing); fish and cephalopod rows unchanged. No online primary copy reachable (FAOLEX and normas.mercosur.int returned 403), so the held scan is the primary text used.

rows.scope: S19—4 table 'Maximum levels of metal contaminants': Contaminant 'Arsenic (inorganic)', Food 'Seaweed' (maximum level in mg/kg)
rows.basis: S19—3(1)(b): 'for a food for which only a portion is ordinarily consumed—a reference to the food is taken to be a reference to that portion'; S19—3(1)(c): 'in the case of seaweed—calculations are to be based on seaweed at 85% hydration'.
rows.evidence: 'Arsenic (inorganic) … Seaweed 1' with 'the maximum level (in mg/kg)' — S19—4 table, F2024C00908 p. 2
rows.primary_source_used: /Users/karenpendergrass/Desktop/heavy-metal-index/raw/regulatory/au-nz/au-nz-fsanz-standard-1-4-1-schedule-19.pdf (Authorised Version F2024C00908, compilation No. 6 as in force 13 Sep 2024, up to Amendment No. 231); status from https://www.legislation.gov.au/F2015L00454/latest (In force; F2024C00908 period 13 Sep 2024–31 Aug 2026); Amendment No. 252 checked at https://www.foodstandards.gov.au/sites/default/files/2026-08/Amendment%20252.pdf
rows.note: 1 mg/kg × 1000 = 1000 µg/kg. Register basis 'portion ordinarily consumed' is S19—3(1)(b) and is not contradicted, but the operative seaweed-specific basis is S19—3(1)(c) (85% hydration normalization), which the register omits — recommend adding. Held copy is compilation No. 6 (F2024C00908, 13 Sep 2024, up to Amendment No. 231). The Federal Register shows it as current with period 13 Sep 2024–31 Aug 2026 because Amendment No. 252 (Gazette FSC 192, 1 Sep 2026, commencing on gazettal) varied Schedule 19; its S19—4 items [1]–[2] alter only the Cadmium entries (molluscs exclusion wording; new 'Blacklip rock oysters (Saccostrea spathulata) 3'), so the Arsenic (inorganic)/Seaweed entry is unchanged as of 2026-09-02; a post-252 compilation is not yet registered. legislation.gov.au status page confirms 'In force'; its text endpoint did not render to fetch.
